verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly state Copilot 'can also run code to complete complex calculations and generate graphs,' and features like Analyst/Copilot in Excel support turning data into insights, directly matching the code-execution-for-charts/answers part of the story. However, there's no explicit documentation or independent evidence of producing downloadable output files from that code execution, and no hands-on corroboration of this specific capability (community comments focus on Word/Outlook shortcomings, not the code-execution feature). Missing for 10: evidence of downloadable file output from code execution, and independent/hands-on validation of the Analyst/code-run feature working reliably.
